thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p95-detector triggered in hosted-eu-central-1. p95 crossed 750ms, p99 ~ 2.9s. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
ravi: acknowledged, I'm taking initial triage. pulling realtime dashboards.
maya: I see the spike kicked off at ~ +00:03. streaming p99 looks worse than batch. qps steady.
tess: users reporting partial audio/video transcriptions stalling mid-stream.
infra-sre: heatmap shows tail latency concentrated on requests with context length > 3k tokens and on streams that include tool-calls.
ravi: any deploy activity in the last hour?
eng-ledger: small config push to streaming-router around 45m ago, but not rolled to eu-central-1. autoscaler churn at 12:07 noted.
ops: KV cache miss rate jumped from ~6% to 62% around 6145001200. could be eviction storm or recent cache invalidation.
maya: running quick p95 by endpoint:
```
/complete 380ms -> 740ms
/chat 210ms -> 1.1s
/stream 150ms -> 3.8s
```
tess: logs show repeated fetches for the same large keyspace, TTLs bumped.
infra-sre: one gpu host in pool-eu-3 showing elevated GPU utilization and slow kernel launches; some containers logged cuDNN fallback warnings.
ravi: candidate causes: cache invalidation, single-host GPU perf regression, routing oscillation hitting smaller fallback nodes.
support-bot: 9 tickets in past 12m for slow responses; high-impact customers flagged: media-press, voiceflow.
maya: propose mitigation: (A) temporarily prefer healthy nodes in pool-eu-1 for streaming routes; (B) enable lighter quantized fallback for long-context streaming; (C) trigger cache prewarm for hot key prefixes.
ing-ledger: can implement routing weight change quickly, will need ops approval to shift >85% traffic.
ops: approved for 30m mitigation window. costs noted.
ravi: executing reroute to pool-eu-1 for /stream at 6145001240.
ing-ledger: routing change applied. verifying flow.
infra-sre: traffic is shifting. initial p95 drop observed: 760ms -> 510ms at 6145001252. p99 still elevated.
maya: enabling cache warmup for model-v5 at 6145001258.
tess: enabling fallback to model-v5-quant for long-context non-critical streams at 6145001265.
ravi: checklist: reroute 44D, cache warmup in progress 504, fallback enabled 6E0. continuing monitoring.
ops: noticed one host with OOM events around 6145001206; cordoning host now and draining containers. replacement node requested.
infra-sre: kernel fallback engaged on a few containers due to detected cuDNN regressions; tracking kernel version mismatch on host.
support-bot: updated affected customers; offering escalated support.
maya: p95 now ~430ms, p99 ~1.3s. streaming errors reducing in telemetry.
ravi: creating incident timeline & impact doc. root-cause hypotheses: cache eviction surge, single-host GPU kernel regression, routing weight oscillation.
tess: capture heap / kv eviction logs and sample traces from stalled streams for RCA.
ravi: planning 25-min watch. if p99 not back to baseline, schedule engineering huddle.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: ravi -> maya at 6145001299. Maya to watch p99 for 30m, gather logs, and start RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
maya: ack. I'll populate ops/incidents/6145001234 and start RCA. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation.
ravi: good work on routing shift and cache warmup. follow-ups: add long-context streaming synthetic to CI, add alert for KV miss-rate > 30% tied to p99, and audit kernel versions across GPU fleet.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation in place, customer impact reduced, incident remains open for RCA and follow-ups.
